Eudia is redefining legal work through AI-powered Augmented Intelligence for enterprise legal teams. The AI Engineer Intern will work with experienced researchers and engineers on machine learning and generative AI problems in the legal domain, including evaluating and fine-tuning models, improving retrieval and reasoning, and testing production-grade AI systems.

Responsibilities
Assist in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions to address customer-specific challenges
Collaborate with senior engineers to build, test, and deploy machine learning models in production environments
Support the development of cloud-agnostic and secure enterprise-grade software solutions
Participate in troubleshooting and optimizing AI/ML models, addressing issues such as model drift and performance bottlenecks
Conduct research and analysis to improve model efficiency and accuracy
Help develop and maintain documentation for AI workflows and deployment processes
Provide input on product development and contribute to enhancing the AI/ML product roadmap

Required
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
Experience with traditional machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or other NLP techniques
Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools such as MLflow for monitoring and deploying machine learning solutions
Exposure to real-world projects involving data analysis, predictive modeling, or automation
Interest in the legal technology domain or experience working with enterprise-grade systems
Benefits
Be part of a team that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.
Work in an environment that encourages professional growth and the exploration of new ideas.
Join a group of passionate, driven individuals who are committed to making a difference.
